And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.
E apartaram-se do caminho para entrar a ter ali a noite em Gibeá; e entrando, sentaram-se na praça da cidade, porque não houve quem os acolhesse em casa para passar a noite.
And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.
E eis que um homem velho, que à tarde vinha do campo de trabalhar; o qual era do monte de Efraim, e morava como peregrino em Gibeá, mas os moradores daquele lugar eram filhos de Benjamim.
And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?
E levantando o velho os olhos, viu aquele viajante na praça da cidade, e disse-lhe: Para onde vais, e de onde vens?

And he said unto him, We are passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Beth-lehem-judah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD ; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.
E ele respondeu: Passamos de Belém de Judá aos lados do monte de Efraim, de onde eu sou; e parti até Belém de Judá; e vou à casa do SENHOR, e não há quem me receba em casa,
Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.
Ainda que nós tenhamos palha e de comer para nossos asnos, e também temos pão e vinho para mim e para tua serva, e para o criado que está com teu servo; de nada temos falta.
And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
E o homem velho disse: Paz seja contigo; tua necessidade toda seja somente a meu cargo, contanto que não passes a noite na praça.
So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.
E metendo-os em sua casa, deu de comer a seus asnos; e eles se lavaram os pés, e comeram e beberam.

Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.

E quando estavam jubilosos, eis que os homens daquela cidade, homens malignos, cercam a casa, e batiam as portas, dizendo ao homem velho dono da casa: Tira fora o homem que entrou em tua casa, para que o conheçamos.
And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay , I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.
E saindo a eles aquele homem, amo da casa, disse-lhes: Não, irmãos meus, rogo-vos que não cometais este mal, pois que este homem entrou em minha casa, não façais esta maldade.
Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.
Eis aqui minha filha virgem, e a concubina dele: eu as tirarei agora para vós; humilhai-as, e fazei com elas como vos parecer, e não façais a este homem coisa tão infame.

But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

Mas aqueles homens não lhe quiseram ouvir; pelo que tomando aquele homem sua concubina, tirou-a fora: e eles a conheceram, e abusaram dela toda a noite até a manhã, e deixaram-na quando apontava a alva.
Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was , till it was light.
E já que amanhecia, a mulher veio, e caiu diante da porta da casa daquele homem onde seu senhor estava, até que foi de dia.

And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.
E levantando-se de manhã seu senhor, abriu as portas da casa, e saiu para ir seu caminho, e eis que, a mulher sua concubina estava estendida diante da porta da casa, com as mãos sobre o umbral.
And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.
E ele lhe disse: Levanta-te, e vamo-nos. Mas ela não respondeu. Então a levantou o homem, e lançando-a sobre seu asno, levantou-se e foi-se a seu lugar.
And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.
E em chegando à sua casa, toma uma espada, pegou sua concubina, e despedaçou-a com seus ossos em doze partes, e enviou-as por todos os termos de Israel.

And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds .
E todo aquele que o via, dizia: Jamais se fez nem visto tal coisa, desde o tempo que os filhos de Israel subiram da terra do Egito até hoje. Considerai isto, dai conselho, e falai.
Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.
Então todos os filhos de Israel saíram, e a congregação reuniu-se como um só homem, desde Dã até Berseba e a terra de Gileade, ao SENHOR em Mispá.
And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
E os chefes de todo aquele povo, de todas as tribos de Israel, se apresentaram na assembleia do povo de Deus, quatrocentos mil homens a pé, aptos para usar espada.
(Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us , how was this wickedness?
Ora, os filhos de Benjamim ouviram que os filhos de Israel haviam subido a Mispá. E os filhos de Israel disseram: “Dizei como foi esta maldade.”
And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
Então o homem levita, marido da mulher que havia sido morta, respondeu e disse: “Eu cheguei a Gibeá de Benjamim com a minha concubina, para passar ali a noite.
And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.
E os homens de Gibeá levantaram-se contra mim, e cercaram a casa de noite, com a intenção de me matar, e violentaram a minha concubina de maneira que ela morreu.
And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.
Então tomei a minha concubina, cortei-a em pedaços, e os enviei por todo o território da possessão de Israel; porquanto fizeram maldade e loucura em Israel.
Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.
Eis aqui, todos vós, filhos de Israel, dai-vos aqui parecer e conselho.”
And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.
Então todo aquele povo, como um só homem, se levantou, e disse: “Nenhum de nós irá para sua tenda, nem nos retiraremos cada um para sua casa,
But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;
até que façamos isto sobre Gibeá: que lancemos sortes contra ela;

And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

e tomaremos dez homens de cada cem por todas as tribos de Israel, e cem de mil, e mil de dez mil, que levem suprimento para o povo que irá contra Gibeá de Benjamim, a fim de fazer conforme toda a abominação que cometeram em Israel.”
So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
Assim juntaram-se contra a cidade todos os homens de Israel, unidos como um só homem.
And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?
E as tribos de Israel enviaram homens por toda a tribo de Benjamim, dizendo: “Que maldade é esta que foi feita entre vós?

Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:
Entregai, pois, agora aqueles homens, malignos, que estão em Gibeá, para que os matemos, e tiremos o mal de Israel.” Mas os de Benjamim não quiseram ouvir a voz de seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel.
But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
Em vez disso, os de Benjamim se ajuntaram das cidades de Gibeá, para saírem a lutar contra os filhos de Israel.
And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.
E foram contados naquele tempo os filhos de Benjamim das cidades, vinte e seis mil homens que usavam espada, além dos que moravam em Gibeá, que foram contados setecentos homens selecionados.
Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss.
De toda esse povo havia setecentos homens selecionados, que eram canhotos, todos os quais atiravam uma pedra com a funda a um fio de cabelo, e não erravam.
And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.
E foram contados os homens de Israel, excluindo os de Benjamim, quatrocentos mil homens que usavam espada, todos esses homens de guerra.

And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah shall go up first.

Os filhos de Israel levantaram-se, subiram a Betel, e perguntaram a Deus, dizendo: “Quem de nós subirá primeiro para guerrear contra os filhos de Benjamim?” E o SENHOR respondeu: “Judá subirá primeiro.”
And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
Levantando-se, pois, os filhos de Israel, pela manhã, acamparam perto de Gibeá.
And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
E os filhos de Israel saíram para combater Benjamim; e os homens de Israel posicionaram-se em ordem de batalha contra eles junto a Gibeá.
And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.
Então os filhos de Benjamim saíram de Gibeá, e derrubaram por terra naquele dia vinte e dois mil homens dos filhos de Israel.
And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.
Mas o povo dos homens de Israel se reanimou, e voltaram a se posicionar em ordem de batalha no mesmo lugar onde se haviam posicionado no primeiro dia.

(And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)

Porque os filhos de Israel subiram e choraram diante do SENHOR até a tarde, e perguntaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: “Voltarei a lutar contra os filhos de Benjamim, meu irmão?” E o SENHOR lhes respondeu: “Subi contra ele.”
And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
Então os filhos de Israel se aproximaram no dia seguinte contra os filhos de Benjamim.
And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.
E naquele segundo dia, Benjamim saiu de Gibeá contra eles, e derrubaram por terra outros dezoito mil homens dos filhos de Israel, todos os quais usavam espada.

Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD , and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

Então todos os filhos de Israel, e todo aquele povo, subiram e vieram a Betel; e choraram, e assentaram-se ali diante do SENHOR, e jejuaram naquele dia até a tarde; e ofereceram holocaustos e sacrifícios pacíficos diante do SENHOR.
And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD , (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,
E os filhos de Israel perguntaram ao SENHOR, (porque a arca do pacto de Deus estava ali naqueles dias,

And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

e Fineias, filho de Eleazar, filho de Arão, apresentava-se diante dela naqueles dias), e disseram: “Voltarei a sair em batalha contra os filhos de Benjamim, meu irmão, ou pararei?” E o SENHOR disse: Subi, que amanhã eu o entregarei em tua mão.”
And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
Então Israel pôs emboscadas ao redor de Gibeá.
And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
E os filhos de Israel subiram contra os filhos de Benjamim no terceiro dia, e se posicionaram em ordem de batalha diante de Gibeá, como das outras vezes.

And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

Então os filhos de Benjamim saíram contra o povo, e afastaram-se da cidade. E começaram a ferir alguns do povo, matando como das outras vezes pelos caminhos, um dos quais sobe para Betel, e o outro para Gibeá pelo campo; e mataram uns trinta homens de Israel.
And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.
E os filhos de Benjamim diziam: “Eles estão derrotados diante de nós, como antes.” Mas os filhos de Israel diziam: “Fugiremos, e os afastaremos da cidade para os caminhos.”
And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.
Então todos os de Israel levantaram-se de seu lugar, e puseram-se em ordem em Baal-Tamar; e também os que estavam nas emboscadas de Israel saíram de seu lugar, a oeste de Gibeá.
And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.
E dez mil homens selecionados de todo Israel vieram contra Gibeá, e a batalha começou a se agravar; mas os de Benjamim não sabiam que o mal se aproximava deles.
And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.
E o SENHOR feriu Benjamim diante de Israel; e os filhos de Israel mataram naquele dia vinte e cinco mil e cem homens de Benjamim, todos os quais usavam espada.
So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.
E os filhos de Benjamim viram que estavam derrotados; pois os filhos de Israel haviam cedido lugar a Benjamim, porque confiavam nas emboscadas que haviam posto perto de Gibeá.
And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
Então os que estavam nas emboscadas atacaram depressa Gibeá, e espalharam-se, e mataram à espada toda a cidade.
Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.
Os israelitas já haviam combinado com os homens das emboscadas, que fizessem subir uma grande nuvem de fumaça da cidade.

And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

Então os de Israel se viraram na batalha. Quando os de Benjamim começaram a matar de Israel uns trinta homens, já diziam: “Certamente eles já estão derrotados diante de nós, como na primeira batalha.”
But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.
Mas quando a nuvem de fumaça começou a subir da cidade, uma coluna de fumaça, Benjamim virou a olhar para trás; e eis que a fumaça da cidade subia ao céu.
And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.
Então os homens de Israel deram meia-volta, e os de Benjamim encheram-se de temor; porque viram que o mal havia vindo sobre eles.
Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.
Eles, pois, voltaram-se de costas diante de Israel até o caminho do deserto; mas o exército os alcançou, e os que saíam das das cidade os matavam no meio deles.
Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.
Assim cercaram os de Benjamim, e os perseguiram e os exterminaram facilmente, desde as proximidades de Gibeá até o oriente.
And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.
E morreram de Benjamim dezoito mil homens, todos eles homens de guerra.

And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.
E dos que se viraram e fugiram para o deserto, até a rocha de Rimom, desses os israelitas exterminaram cinco mil homens nos caminhos; e os perseguiram até Gidom, e mataram deles dois mil homens.
So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.
Assim todos os que de Benjamim morreram naquele dia foram vinte e cinco mil homens que usavam espada, todos eles homens de guerra.
But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.
Porém se viraram e fugiram ao deserto até a rocha de Rimom seiscentos homens, os quais ficaram na rocha de Rimom durante quatro meses.

And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.
E os homens de Israel voltaram aos filhos de Benjamim, e os mataram à espada, homens e animais na cidade, e tudo o que foi achado; também puseram fogo em todas as cidades que acharam.
Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
E os homens de Israel haviam jurado em Mispá, dizendo: “Nenhum de nós dará sua filha aos de Benjamim por mulher.”
And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
E veio o povo à casa de Deus, e estiveram ali até à tarde diante de Deus; e levantando sua voz fizeram um grande pranto, e disseram:
And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
“Ó SENHOR, Deus de Israel, por que sucedeu isto em Israel, que falte hoje uma tribo em Israel?”
And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
E no dia seguinte o povo se levantou de manhã, e edificaram ali altar, e ofereceram holocaustos e sacrifícios pacíficos.

And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

E os filhos de Israel disseram: “Quem de todas as tribos de Israel não subiu à assembleia diante do SENHOR?” Porque haviam feito um grande juramento contra quem não subisse ao SENHOR em Mispá, dizendo: “Certamente morrerá.”
And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
E os filhos de Israel se arrependeram por causa de Benjamim, seu irmão, e disseram: “Uma tribo foi hoje cortada de Israel.
How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?
Que faremos quanto a mulheres para os que restaram? Pois nós juramos pelo SENHOR que não lhes daríamos nossas filhas por mulheres.”
And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD ? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
E disseram: “Há alguém das tribos de Israel que não tenha subido ao SENHOR em Mispá?” E descobriram que ninguém de Jabes-Gileade havia vindo ao acampamento à assembleia;
For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.
porque, quando o povo foi contado, não havia ali homem nenhum dos moradores de Jabes-Gileade.

And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.
Então a congregação enviou para lá doze mil homens dos mais valentes, e ordenou-lhes, dizendo: “Ide e matai à espada os moradores de Jabes-Gileade, incluindo as mulheres e os meninos.
And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.
Mas fareis desta maneira: matareis todo homem e toda mulher que tiver se deitado com homem.”

And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
E acharam dos moradores de Jabes-Gileade quatrocentas virgens que não tinham se deitado com homem, e as trouxeram ao acampamento em Siló, que está na terra de Canaã.
And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
Então toda a congregação enviou a falar aos filhos de Benjamim que estavam na penha de Rimom, e lhes anunciou a paz.
And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.
Então os de Benjamim voltaram; e deram-lhes por mulheres as que haviam preservado vivas das mulheres de Jabes-Gileade; mas não lhes foram suficientes.
And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
E o povo teve compaixão por causa de Benjamim, porque o SENHOR havia feito uma brecha nas tribos de Israel.
Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
Então os anciãos da congregação disseram: “Que faremos quanto a mulheres para os que restaram? Porque as mulheres de Benjamim foram exterminadas.”
And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.
E disseram: “Deve haver herdeiros dos que sobreviveram de Benjamim, para que uma tribo não seja eliminada de Israel.
Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.
Nós, porém, não lhes podemos dar mulheres de nossas filhas, porque os filhos de Israel juraram, dizendo: ‘Maldito aquele que der mulher a um homem de Benjamim.’”

Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
Então disseram: “Eis que a cada ano há uma solenidade do SENHOR em Siló, ao norte de Betel, e a leste do caminho que sobe de Betel a Siquém, ao sul de Lebona.”
Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
E mandaram aos filhos de Benjamim, dizendo: “Ide, e escondei-vos nas vinhas;

And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
E observai; quando virdes as filhas de Siló saindo para dançar, vós saireis das vinhas, e arrebatareis cada um sua mulher das filhas de Siló, e ireis à terra de Benjamim.

And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.

E quando vierem os pais delas ou seus irmãos para reclamarem a nós, então lhes diremos: ‘Por nós, tende piedade deles; pois na guerra não conseguimos mulheres para todos; e, como não fostes vós que as destes a eles, agora não sois culpados.’”

And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
E os filhos de Benjamim fizeram assim; tomaram mulheres conforme o número deles, tomando das que dançavam; e se foram, e voltaram à sua herança, reconstruíram as cidades, e habitaram nelas.
And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
Então os filhos de Israel se foram também dali, cada um à sua tribo e à sua família, saindo dali cada um à sua propriedade.
In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
Naqueles dias não havia rei em Israel; cada um fazia o que parecia certo aos seus próprios olhos.
